cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Approve the Harmless Version
cards.instruction: Get approval for a harmless version of your plan, then gradually reveal what that approval now commits them to.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Can a couple of relatives come for tea? Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Good. They're bringing the cousins who introduced them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It starts with the approved couple. The rest is family context.
